subject: Leadership lightning reads + QBR checklist
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com, jonas_weber@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T08:12:00-07:00
Subject: Leadership lightning reads + QBR checklist

Morning all — one quick, focused update ahead of next week's QBR. Kept this intentionally short (lightning reads) so leadership can skim.

Wins
- Hosted API latency improvements: 95th pctl down 12% after runtime kernel tweaks (perf team). Impact measured on nightly load test.
- Two mid-market pilots converted to paid trials this week (ACME & Borealis). Revenue ARR motion picking up.
- New Dedicated autoscale policy shipped to staging; initial throughput numbers look within SLA targets.

Risks / Chokepoints
- Model onboarding backlog: Quantization + perf tuning queue is 3 models deep; if not cleared, Dedicated capacity utilization will hit a limit during Q3 rollouts.
- Security questionnaire from Borealis requests audit log retention proof beyond standard SOC artifacts; may push procurement timeline.
- One of the GPU supplier shipment windows slipped a week — minor, but could affect short-term Dedicated ramp if other risks materialize.

Asks (clear owners & timelines)
- Karthik: finalize quantization schedule for the three queued models by EOD Wed (2027-05-05). We need ETA to present during QBR.
- Jonas: can you pull a 3-slide backup on cost-per-token trends (Mar → Apr) and include a short note on batching gains? Slide needed by Thu COB.
- Priyom: own the Borealis security thread; ask for exact evidence they need and coordinate with Security to provide short turnaround (48 hrs) if possible.
- Laura: decision on trade-off for preemptive purchase of the spare GPU nodes (yes/no) so we can reserve capacity in supplier pipeline this week.

Attachments: QBR_prep_slide_deck_v1.pdf (master deck with blanks), okrs-quarterly-snapshot.csv (raw numbers). There is a Drive link in related_links for collaboration.

Notes: I added a one-slide summary for each win/risk and left placeholders where we need data (Karthik/Jonas).

Thanks — will follow up with updated deck Thursday morning.

— Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Product Ops, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(Attachment: QBR_prep_slide_deck_v1.pdf)

From: Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: 2027-05-02T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership lightning reads + QBR checklist

Thanks Marissa — concise and useful. Quick clarifications:
- For the latency stat, can you link the nightly test doc or include the absolute median/95 numbers on the slide? I want both relative and absolute numbers for the deck.
- On batching gains: should we show cost per 1k tokens before/after or raw per-token? I'll prepare both but want direction.

I'll draft the 3-slide backup and post to the Drive by Thu AM; will annotate where I made assumptions.

Jonas
Director, Performance Engineering
jonas_weber@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-05-02T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership lightning reads + QBR checklist

Thanks — this is the kind of signal I want in the QBR. A couple of items: 

- Jonas: include absolute numbers (median, p95) + % delta. Keep one slide that shows business impact (cost savings estimate) so execs can see $$ impact.
- Karthik: prioritize the quantization schedule and identify any blockers that require hiring or contractor support. If the queue cannot be cleared by end of next week, prepare a mitigation plan with expected downstream impact.
- Marissa: regarding GPU pre-purchase, let's not yet commit. Karthik and Finance should run model-demand scenarios and present a recommendation by Friday. I'll approve if downside risk > 15% on missed revenue targets.

Forwarding Marissa's note below for visibility.

Date: 2027-05-02T17:46:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Leadership lightning reads + QBR checklist

Received — thanks all. Quick notes: 
- Jonas: I'll add absolute numbers to the latency slide and drop the summary into Drive by 9am Thu.
- Karthik: starting a short sync with the infra team at 9:30am to unblock quantization questions; will escalate hiring ask if we see a multi-week blocker.
- Priyom: looping in Security now (internal) to get Borealis evidence request triaged — I'll cc you on the thread.
- Laura: we'll model GPU scenarios and aim to have a recommendation by Fri morning.

I'll post an updated deck (v1.1) and mark slides with who owns which piece. If anything else, shout here — otherwise expect deliverables Thu/ Fri as noted.

— Marissa
